hedges: Most attributions are labelled 'Suspected attribution' in the report rather than confirmed.
The report says it assesses that APT34 works for the Iranian government, based on infrastructure references and targeting.
The report says APT37 is assessed with high confidence to act on behalf of the North Korean government.
The report says it has not observed APT39 exploit vulnerabilities.
The report says APT15 shares backdoors and infrastructure not unique to it, which makes attribution challenging.
The report says APT28 most likely receives resources from the Russian government, based on its working hours.
The report says very little has been released publicly about APT18.
Several groups are described as likely freelancers with some nation-state sponsorship, including APT9, APT19 and APT20.
